title: Ned's Gift
checkpoint: Reception Summer 2, week 4 — Phase 4: Longer and compound words: longer words and compound words (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 complete, 76-sound stage (nd, nt, nk, ft, lt, lf just added).

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling walking along a garden path, looking down at the ground.
Ned the duckling noticing a small bent metal pin glinting on the path.
Ned the duckling spotting a small flat pale shell beside the path.
Ned the duckling finding a small pink wood chip on the path.

pages.text: Ned has a bent pin, a flat shell and a pink chip.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling holding the pin, shell and pink chip together, looking pleased.

pages.text: Ned fits them on a string.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling threading the pin, shell and chip carefully onto a length of string.

pages.text: Ned has a gift for Nell.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling holding up the finished string of little treasures.
Nell the bee taking the string of treasures from Ned the duckling.

pages.text: Nell grins at Ned. What a good gift!
pages.illustration: Nell the bee grinning widely, holding the little string of treasures up proudly.
